text: In sixteen twenty-eight, Sweden launched the mightiest warship on Earth. It sailed thirteen hundred metres.
The king wanted more firepower, so she got a second gun deck. Sixty-four cannons, stacked up high. Not nearly enough ballast down low.
Before sailing, thirty men ran across her deck to test her stability. After three runs, she rolled so badly they stopped the test. Then they sailed anyway.
A light gust tipped her. Water poured in through the open gunports, and she sank in the harbour. About thirty people died.
Three runs told them everything. Dave asked for a fourth.
